name: Rocket Fuel - (1g) Live Resin - Cap Junky
description:
Fresh-frozen flavor, straight from the jar. Rocket Fuel Cap Junky live resin delivers 1 gram of full-spectrum concentrate, extracted from fresh-frozen flower to lock in the terpenes and aroma the plant started with — bold, flavorful, and made for dabbing.

Cap Junky is a hybrid with a reputation for serious potency, born from crossing Alien Cookies with Kush Mints. Expect a loud, complex profile: sharp gas and sour funk up front, layered with cool mint and a sweet, earthy finish. Because it's live resin, every dab hits with deeper flavor and a fuller, more well-rounded effect — a heavy, fast-moving punch that's best saved for experienced concentrate lovers.

Why you'll love it:

1G live resin — fresh-frozen extraction for maximum terpene preservation
Full-spectrum flavor — rich, aromatic, and true to the strain
Signature Cap Junky flavor — sharp gas and sour funk with cool mint and sweet earth
Jar packaging — easy to scoop, easy to store, ready to dab

Big flavor, premium potency, and true-to-plant character in every gram. Rocket Fuel Cap Junky is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Requires a compatible dab rig or vaporizer.
